bit_quad_euler =: 4 : 0

    for_py. _1+i.height+1 do.
        for_px. _1+i.width+1 do.

            b =. x occupied (px+1),py
            c =. x occupied px,py+1
            d =. x occupied (px+1),py+1

    end.
    sign =. 2

otsu =: 3 : 0

isodata =: 3 : 0
    'counts belowcounts belowsums total count minimum maximum median mode levels binwidth bins' =. y
    cutoff =. total div count
    iterations =. 0
    while. 1 do.
        below =. cutoff{belowcounts
        above =. count-below

        if. iterations=100 do. break. end.
    end.
    cutoff,iterations
